author: Re 728 iei
title: Step count???
review: What happened to goals based on step count?? You need to give an option. Do you just randomly have an idea and run with it without thinking of the impact?? I walked 3 miles today but didn't meet your idea of "activity" so I am at 0%. Plus your sleep needs some updating.

author: Daisumi.1
title: Where's my steps tracker?!
review: Hate the new update. I understand in theory how it would be nice to add activities but why take away the step tracker?! Why not add more functions overall instead of subtracting?

author: Yddrghkjjijuufgffgggcuullllll
title: Please take this 'update' back
review:
When goals changed from steps to active minutes, you turned this activity tracker into a very expensive, but pretty, exercise log. With the latest update I can at least access activities without a crash but if you don't let me go back to using this as an activity tracker -i.e. Steps or distance as a goal vs some arbitrary 'active minutes' - I'll be requesting a refund for the whole thing and dust off my old Fitbit. 

Very disappointed.

author: PippiAnn
title: Loading/sync issues
review: The app needs a lot of improvement.  When it does work it's just okay.  I've been trying to open the app for 2 days and it won't open.  The days prior to that it would take multiple tries to sync.  If I delete the app I'll lose my data... Needs work.

author: galadriel99
title: Meh.
review:
This is the first fitness tracker I've owned. 
I thought it would do more in terms of biometrics. 

Step counter/motion seems to work best when Leaf is a broach.  As a necklace, it doesn't count any of my activity. 

I like that it tells me when I've been sedentary for too long, but it doesn't always seem to count certain movements. 

The app itself has about the same amount of "wow factor," that is, not much. 

So far in the app's development, it is self-contained. I'd like to be able to integrate it with the iPhone's built-in Health tracker app. I have a few other fitness apps that I use as well; this would provide a more comprehensive overview of my activity level. 

I would like the app to make the Leaf buzz as acknowledgement when it's done syncing.

author: aadams67
title: Upgrade Fail
review: I know the intention was to better the software but it really stinks! It's not motivational or encouraging to have walked 4 miles but yet have 0 activity recorded! I wish it would revert back to the previous version!!

author: Tlmarm
title: Changes
review: I do not care for the change to the goals section. There had been a goal set by amount of steps, the change to the amount of active time is not preferable

author: Milfy2010
title: Fitbit for the win
review: I've had the Fitbit HR and now have the leaf and I prefer the app for the Fitbit HR and regret giving it to my husband. Would be nice if the app was more like Fitbit. I have to rose gold leaf and I'm not really impressed considering I paid the same amount

author: MKSusanW
title: Nothing
review: After the November update, the app registers nothing when I sync. I know it's working as the alarm works. They took away the steps per day goal and distance walked and gave us an activity goal that maxes out at an hour and ten minutes which is not motivational or useful for me.

author: Archaeokassiopeia
title: Some Updates not working
review: I love some of the updates - the sleep is recording more accurately and I really appreciate that it is starting to consider more than walking. But the "add activity" section isn't working - it won't let me select an or add an activity. Hope this gets corrected soon!

author: Runnergirl1121
title: When Adding Activity No Activity Appears
review: I was so happy when I saw that now we can add activity. But when I go to add the activity there is nothing there. No activities are listed... At least it doesn't crash like it did before but now it doesn't have any activities to choose from. Fix please!!! (Using on iPhone 6, OS 9.1)

author: Flanna2222222
title: Sooooo close...
review:
Well, they finally added the ability to add specific activities that has been advertised for awhile (give your developers a break, guys, and don't promise stuff before it's ready for prime time). As usual, though, with this app it's just not ready. There are so many bugs. 

Also, New fitness goals are confusing... What if I want a step goal rather than an active time goal? (I mean, what is active time anyway??) We should be able to choose one or the other. 

Biggest baddest bug: activities almost work but your pull down of activities is not populated with anything yet.

author: K.Rollin
title: Better but not awesome...
review: Still unable to add custom activities. Nothing loads after clicking to add an activity.

author: toricrzy
title: New add activity not working
review: The new update includes adding your own activity but whenever I click on the field to add which "Activity", the app crashes and returns to my phone's home screen. I've been waiting for this update since I do so many activities that don't register on the leaf. But it seems I still can't use it. :(

author: Disappointed LEAF owner
title: Update doesn't help
review: I've owned the leaf for 2 months. The app has had many updates and is still a fail. Think you can add activities now? Nice try, the app just closes.

author: Stephers2012
title: Like previous version better
review: Just got the new update for the app and already don't like it as much as the first. Now it only tracks your progress for active time. Before if you had a step goal you set your self to meet each day it would show your progress through out the day. Now I have to be active for a set amount of mins. Please give the option in the next update to set it so you can choose if you want and activity goal or step goal!!!!

author: Fairlyfairy
title: New update
review: I love the idea! But the app keeps crashing when I try to add a new activity card. Hopefully this gets fixed soon!

author: ReenieCate
title: Beautiful, sort of Useful
review:
The leaf is beautiful and fits with my style so I wear it all the time.

While the app works alright, I do think there could be many improvements.

There are only 3 things it tracks: sleep, steps, and it does breathing exercises.

It usually gets my sleep wrong, thinking I woke up for good when I actually just got up to use the bathroom.

One day it didn't track anything for about 10 hours. I didn't manually update it, but when I did late in the day it had only tracked the last hour or so.

It would be nice if I could input things or notes, similar to the PTracker app. It'd be nice to mark off my moods and any monthly symptoms, and medications I've taken. It would also be nice if it could like into other apps like the Apple Health app.

I'll still keep wearing it as long as it's still tracking my steps, but not sure if I would buy it again. It's so pretty and has so much potential! I wish it worked a little better.

A design teacher once told me, "If it's beautiful you'll make it useful. If it's useful, you'll make it beautiful."

author: Brod0420
title: New "update" ruined it
review: I enjoyed the simplicity of the tracker and the app before the latest update. It will not open anymore. It crashes immediately after the load screen. So I can't use my leaf until they fix it? Seems like a waste of $99!

author: LameLameLameWasteOfTimeLame
title: Terrible support - inaccurate tracker
review: I have emailed support three times and have not gotten a response to my question. The leaf does not track any steps unless you go 50 steps at one time. You are missing out on the tracking of hundreds of steps a day. What is the point if an activity tracker if it is not accurate? Also when I ordered it was a promo that included a bracelet and the necklace. The bracelet was not included. It is a beautiful device and I will likely return for a refund since support does not care to address my concern. If you want pretty, buy a piece of jewelry. If you want accurate, but a Fit Bit because the Leaf falls terribly short.

author: Kemmiebaker
title: Poor delivery options
review: I just got my shipping e-mail from them.  They sent it USPS delivery confirmation.  Unfortunately, I live in a rural area where they won't deliver confirmation items.  You can't request delivery either.  Instead, I have to drive 25 minutes each way to the post office, during work hours.  If I had known that I had to take off from work to get this, I'd have never bought it.  There are similar items that are much much easier to get.  I hate this already, and I don't even have it (if I can find time during our busy season to even get the thing)

author: Jesstraveling
title: Great Device - App is behind the times
review:
The Leaf is a light, stylish and functional device but the app is missing many features.  For example:
- No data integration with other fitness apps 
- No graphical trends over prolonged periods of time

Hopefully the next version will be better!

author: DesLast
title: Leaf!
review: I love my leaf! It's so nice knowing how well my sleep was and how many steps I've taken throughout the day! The only thing I'd say is maybe have an option to write notes on breathing/steps/sleeping, so I could go back and read what I really felt or did that day! :)

author: Fifi Woodhead
title: Love my Leaf Bellabeat
review: Everything about the Leaf is just so pretty. The product, the style and even the app is pretty! The app syncs to the leaf perfectly giving great insight to my daily life routines.

author: dDBlythe
title: So pretty but...
review: There is definitely room for improvement with the app. I've been told repeatedly when I write to Bellabeat that they were going to update the app in October 2015 to add the ability to enter activities manually a'la MyFitnessPal, Runkeeper, etc...still waiting. I'm really tired of it coaching me to get some exercise on days when I've done a 90min vinyasa yoga class!!

author: Christiana Elle
title: Worthless piece of jewelry and terrible app
review: Please go buy a fitness tracker that actually supports its customers and provides a warranty. These flimsy and bulky devices fall off like its a full time job, not to mention the customer service's inability to do anything other than copy and paste generic responses. 0/10 I won't order anything advertised like this crap again.

author: Mdlgs
title: Dawn
review: Sleep tracking almost non existent. When it does work , it's completely inaccurate. Now, it will not sync . Emails to bellabeat not answered. I really wanted to love this. =(

author: JT PHONE HOME
title: Nothing but problems!
review: Sleep tracking was not accurate. Now no data for past 3 days. Second time there has been no data at all for long period of time. Was working fine before all of these recent updates. I've only had my leaf for a little over a month. More of a pain at this point. Issues need to be fixed!

author: Germanphile
title: Wonderful device and great app
review: Loving my leaf! And the app is working great. Would be nice to be able to add info/annotate my activity and sleep patterns so that it's more telling of what I've actually done. Features added so far are sweet.

author: tiny zo
title: Accuracy very questionable
review: The sleep accuracy of this device and app is appalling. I may as well keep my own records. Although I can change my bed time and wake up time it in no way measures all the times I am a awake during the night. I also don't think "tracks your health" is a claim this app can make until they integrate some other features such as a food/weight tracker/diary as well.

author: Jacquie Frost
title: I think it'll get better...?
review: So it keeps skipping days, it'll just not record for a couple days and then go back to working. :/

author: Bogglechamp123
title: Love the leaf, want more features!
review: Love the leaf. I get a lot of compliments on it as jewellery. I like that it tracks my sleep and activity, it is getting more accurate over time. I would like more app features such as being able to share or upload data, chart of data by week or month. And a function to track mood, stress or add comments each day. I like the breathing exercises and alarm function.

author: StormyOwl3
title: Updates made it horrible!
review: I got my leaf a few weeks before the latest update. I was excited because the email said the update would add activities & other options we didn't have. Not the case. My leaf has been running horrible ever since. Stopped tracking my awake times at night. Isn't counting all my steps. My breathing isn't saving. If you ask me the updates have the Leaf more glitches!!! Everyone I've talked to is having the same issues! And no one can get ahold of anyone at Bellabeat! Please fix ASAP!

author: Lady Astrid
title: Not quite right
review: Either the device itself is doing a poor job of measuring activity, or the app is doing a terrible job of processing the data. I think both. The clip is the recommended placement, but I've been wearing mine that way for a few days and it really only tracks my sleep. I got an alert to say that I've barely moved in five days-- I've definitely been moving. I was cleaning house and got the vibration alert that I had been inactive for 2 straight hours, WHILE I was cleaning! My LEAF wasn't the best at tracking my activity before, but the update has made this even worse. Two stars for tracking my sleep.

author: Brelovespinning
title: Good start, but needs work
review:
Love the Leaf and the idea behind it. I know a Fitbit or other tech would make me obsessive where it is not needed. 

However, the activity tracker isn't accurate. I ran a competitive race recently and the Leaf shorted me more than a mile (in a 13.1mi race). 

Neither is the sleep monitor. Example, I find it odd that the tracker cannot register when I have to get up in the middle of the night with the baby - still registers me as asleep. 

Last note, since most recent update the Leaf will vibrate but when I sync with the app there is no notification. It is very annoying to be notified for no reason. 

That being said, it has helped me gently shift my habits to be healthier. 

Thanks for this novel, beautiful piece of tech!  I look forward to see how it evolves.

author: Tiffany647
title: It's ok
review: I like that you wear the leaf on your clothing instead of on your wrist like other devices. I like that it tracks sleep and seems to track steps well. But I don't like that every single time I want to check my data I have to double tap the LEAF it self in order to sync. My Bluetooth is constantly on, both the phone and the leaf, so I feel like when I open the app and push the sink button that should be enough. I don't always have my hands free in order to double tap to leave to sync. Although this may seem trivial, I don't like having to do it every time.

author: hmp227
title: Love it
review: I am not in very good health and am bed ridden most of the time. This is a great way to remind myself to get up and move as much as I can. Having a goal to work towards each day helps too. And people now believe me when I say I never sleep more than 3 hours a night!

author: Mndzle
title: Not tracking my steps
review:
I've taken 2400 steps
Today according to my iPhone. But my bellabeat app says I haven't even gotten out of bed. It did track my sleep. But I'm not sure why my steps are not being recorded.

author: Brunxeyedxbelle
title: Need some improvements
review:
My App has been having trouble syncing with my Leaf since the last update. Please fix this. 

Also, please include a way to manually add activity. I swim a few times a week and can't add that into my activity tracking. 

I did like the added feature of being able to select where you wear your activity monitor. I do sometimes wear it different ways on different days and nights. Can the app be updated to that you can pick how you wore the tracker that day and that night?

author: Jgreen0082
title: Disappointed
review: It sounded great in theory, but it doesn't track breathing unless you download the track which I can't get it to download. The steps are pretty accurate, but not the sleep cycle. It is not waterproof either.

author: StaciReneeCohen
title: Confused
review:
I love the lead but the app would be better if it allowed you to set vibrations. Sometimes I don't know why the thing is buzzing at me. Maybe an option of 4 buzzes for alarms, 3 for inactivity, 2 for reminder, etc, and an option to track your food/water intake would be great. 

I like the sleep monitor and its precision, and the activity log shows me which parts of my day I tend to be under active. Being aware is half the battle for me sometimes.

author: Lady_Di_CO
title: Oops
review:
The update to the sleep tracking looks nice and I'm excited to see how much more accurate it gets knowing where I'm wearing it but the app crashes every time I try to select a location.
Everything else looks good though.

author: Taydin
title: Update not well tested before deployed
review: When you update how you wear it when you sleep, the app crashed, every time. Other than that, it works better.

author: Darkfrizzle
title: Pretty, but flawed
review: Love the appearance of my leaf but that is about all, unfortunately. I've had it about 3 weeks now and feel mostly disappointed. Sleep tracking is poor; I have to manually edit time every night. Also, even on nights where I've woken and gotten up, it tracks me as asleep the whole night. And nights I sleep fitfully, it reports 98% quality sleep... Not really sure what it's tracking as quality sleep. Fitness wise, I've had two days now where it's told me I've taken zero steps; this is very much not the case! Haven't used the breathing beyond the first training, which I found way too rapidly paced. I was under the impression--like many others as I've read--that it would monitor my breathing pattern and suggest breathing exercises if it detected stress/shallow breathing. I'm very underwhelmed by the period tracker as well; way too basic to be helpful. And you can't track any symptoms that might be cycle related. I just signed up to take surveys after each update, but I haven't experienced an update yet (I was under the impression they update weekly...?). Overall, disappointed with all but how it looks for the price paid.

author: Pelzer12
title: My health is under control
review: I always wanted an app like this to monitor my health in all possible aspects. I think LEAF is the one for me. My health data is accurately tracked and neatly presented so I can exactly know what's going on

author: FeistyNC
title: Fun!
review: I'm a couple months in now. I like the wake up alarm. Accuracy should be improved. Step count is fairly accurate when worn as a bracelet, decent as a clip at the waist, not so good as a clip on a top, and pretty bad as a necklace. I'd really like to see the addition of a social feature so people can "compete" with friends over step counts. Best would be to interface with other apps, like MFP. FWIW, the sleep tracking is accurate for me since I wear it as a clip on my pajama pants at the waist.

author: Bestjacker158
title: Perfect for me
review: This app is so convenient. Mainly because I can get rid of my phone. I can sync the device once a week and it keeps all my data. It's perfect for me. Am also really happy with the in-app period calendar

author: Continuing User
title: Getting seriously annoyed
review: Ever since the last update I haven't been able to log in to my account. I had set it up through Facebook login, and now it just loops back to the email login every time I click the Facebook link. Haven't been able sinc my leaf in weeks... FIX THIS NOW. Other than that it's a fairly decent fitness tracker and I'm looking forward to further improvements. Doesn't seem to recognize yoga as exercise..

author: KatelynHN
title: User manual?
review:
So far I'm impressed with the app and what it CAN do but I don't understand any of it. It took me two days before I realized I had to manually sync it (and figuring out how was an accident) in order to track my sleep and not just the hours I slept. However, I can't find anywhere how to interpret the graph of how I slept. The breathing exercises are vague and I don't understand how to improve my accuracy (and oh my goodness, that bell is so annoying!!). I can't find ANYWHERE how to use the app. 
Ps, the period tracker is kind of a lame feature. There are so many other apps out there that do the same thing. I guess I don't know what I expected, but so far I'm just using this thing as a motivation to walk everywhere. It's super cute to wear though!

author: hanoi1988
title: A nice complete experience
review: The alarms are a pretty nice feature. Up to three are available plus the inactivity alarm. I can set the sensitivity of the inactivity alarm and it motivates me to get up for a few minutes each time it vibrates on the LEAF device… Heard there’s rumours that the app will also work without the device. But I think it’s great to have both for the complete experience.

author: Davodavo360
title: A nice complete experience
review: The alarms are a pretty nice feature. Up to three are available plus the inactivity alarm. I can set the sensitivity of the inactivity alarm and it motivates me to get up for a few minutes each time it vibrates on the LEAF device… Heard there’s rumours that the app will also work without the device. But I think it’s great to have both for the complete experience.

author: TonyAn84
title: Efficient and beautiful!
review: I really love this product! I’ve been looking for a health tracker that’s efficient AND beautiful and this one is both. I’ve been tracking my sleep and activity and so far, so good :).

author: JuliaMoon9494
title: Feeling Optimistic
review:
I have only used the LEAF for a couple days now and so far I think it is pretty good. I did not receive the promised bracelet with my order but have contacted the company and hope it will arrive soon. The accuracy has not been spot-on but it gives me a good general idea of my sleep and activity patterns. Since it is a relatively new product and app I hope there will be improvements, new features and bug fixes to come. It would also be great if it could sync with other health apps such as Apple health or MyFitnessPal. 
So far I am enjoying my LEAF and at least it is very pretty!

author: Thomas Hun
title: My favorite period tracker
review: It’s my favourite new period tracker and activity monitor. This might be very useful to some girls. There is a great breathing exercise in the app called the "menstrual discomfort exercise” - I know... but it’s great. During my period cramps are present almost all of the time, and sometimes it gets really heavy. I've tried this exercise and it helps. It doesn’t make the cramps magically disappear but if I combine this exercise with a warm bath it’s just fine. Just excited to share it :).l

author: zlizard01
title: A little upset
review: The app and leaf was working and tracking really well for me until the last update. Now it doesn't hardly track my steps at all. I hope the next update fixes this problem.

author: Ralambert86
title: It's pretty but has area for improvement in function
review:
First off, I LOVE the way my leaf looks! I get a ton of compliments and love it just for that reason. But it could be more functional. I wish you could manually add activities. It needs a place to track water intake, weight, measurements, moods/symptoms/notes for each day, and some type of GPS tracking. 

I had high hopes for the breathing exercises. And while I enjoy them, the accuracy percentage is not well explained. In fact, nothing is explained very well in this app. So a FAQ/tutorial would be helpful. Also breathing exercises that help to promote sleep would be awesome. 

I will continue to wear my leaf because it's pretty and I hope that future updates will increase its function in my life.

author: Linstaa
title: Useless
review: The sleep program needs to be developed. No information given on quality of sleep. Only obvious observations based on bed time and wake up time. Can't register that you may wake and go back to sleep. No comments on time awake during the night, time it took to get back to sleep or quality. I was up between 2:30 - 4:30 am and it states I got 88% of my goal of 8hrs sleep per night. Given I went to bed just before 12, woke at 2:30 and returned to bed at 4am before getting up at 7am, I think I've wasted my money. This will be going straight back to the manufacturer if I don't get some useful info at the end of tonight.

author: Misscellanie12345
title: has potential but riddled with issues
review:
Pros:
- can set up alarms to remind you during the day
- aesthetically pleasing

Cons:
- alarms are not very effective when you’re sleeping because they’re too weak
- sleep tracker is grossly inaccurate
- don’t like the breathing exercises
—

I’ve had the leaf for about 1 and 1/2 weeks, and I’ve found it to be a WIP than a final product.
Still debating whether or not I will return it in the next couple weeks. Depends on how customer support will respond to my email.

author: Chespen
title: Worked for a few days never very accurate
review: After waiting for months I was very disappointed in this tracker. It does not track steps inside house and is very inaccurate outside. The sleep tracker quit working right after a week or so! I have either a clunky piece of jewelry or an expensive pedometer . Customer service very slow.A better app is promised but I am not too sanguine after so many disappointments.

author: Salvador32
title: Intuitive and simple, love it
review: My favorite health monitoring application. Intuitive interface, easy to use, just keeping it simple and it has a great period calendar. The new app update for iOS should enable us to enter specific activities so it can be more accurate

author: SamClark123
title: The breathing exercises rock!
review: I generally like how this app is designed, simple but beautiful. But the breathing exercises… just great. I didn’t expect to have such a positive impact on my sleep. I do an exercise almost every night before sleep since I got it. Warmly recommend it. zzzzzzzzzzz :)

author: TuanPham12
title: Clean, simple!
review: Sleep tracking is awesome, activity tracking is just as good as fitbit’s. Breathing exercises are definitely a pro for me. Clean, simple, and a great way to start the day. Recommended - but you’ll have to buy the device first.

author: Snark_Victory225
title: Needs Some Improvements/Guidance
review:
I have two main issues with the Leaf. First I think it is a huge flaw to not be able to add activity, at all. It would be ideal to add from other trackers or fitness trackers or gps watch companies online trackers or apps like runkeeper; or to add water activities since it is not water resistant/proof. While it is possible to add sleep manually it would be better to simply be able to put the leaf into sleep mode, for afternoon naps or the person who has a night shift.

The second request/recommendation is the app and the device both need to come with more guidance and suggestions. Instructions on how to best wear the leaf to track sleep, or breathing or recommendation on syncing procedures to save battery life which I only read on the app's development section. The stress reduction breathing could also work better as it doesn't really give feedback. Also if you could alert the app to how and where you wear the leaf would be helpful perhaps also for the app designer.

I have really high hopes the developers will address these issues because other than those things, I love the look of the leaf. Super gorgeous.

author: Aaasgygcdhng
title: App isn't good.
review: I really like the LEAF itself but the app isn't very good at all :-/ especially after using the FitBit app for over a year. Specifically what is frustrating for me is that the breathing exercises don't work on the app. I sync my Leaf and press play and nothing happens. The scrubber says 00:00 out of 00:00. Just frustrating that a huge component of the marketed features doesn't even work.

author: Katleek
title: Not impressed
review: I'm not sure if it's the app or the actual product itself but I feel like I spent way too much money on something that barely works like advertised. Pretty much all it does is poorly track steps. The sleep portion doesn't really work..you have to enter in the time you were asleep. A couple times I've done it and it says I was apparently in deep sleep the whole time.. The way the breathing portion is advertised makes you think it always tracks breathing..my thought was it tracked your breathing and would alert you if it felt you were anxious or whatever and then have you do a breathing exercise to calm down. Nope they only have breathing exercises that give you an accuracy rating that isn't explained. Right now I feel like I wasted my money..hopefully some updates will improve this product. Right now it's just a pretty piece of jewelry.

author: BBogusz
title: Loved it but....
review: It was great in the beginning but now after not even a week it's not tracking all my steps or sleep. Really disappointed in the app and product

author: Happytoyelp
title: Pretty app, limited functionality
review: Excited to start using Leaf for lifestyle tracking and am excited for the October update that's supposed to allow adding in activity. Until, it would be great if they could sync with other apps like myfitness pal for calorie tracking or argus for activity tracking with gps capability

author: Latang
title: Hoping they make improvements
review: This is a nice concept. The sensor is not accurate though. Like the other reviewer, it does not register my sleep on time. The step counter also seems to be an underestimation. The calorie counter is misleading- does not increase with workout. It would be nice if there was somewhere to input these things into the app.

author: life’s a beach
title: Love it BUT...
review: This app is still in its infancy stage. It is just a simple sleep tracker, menstrual cycle tracker and step tracker. I would like to see a gps attached to the app. So you can track your areas you walked and what activity you did during those steps, like aerobics, weights, run or walk etc.  I would like to see a weight tracker so you can track if you gained or lost weight. For the sleep tracker I would like to tell me if I was restless or just normal sleep movements. For the period tracker I would like it to also be able log your symptoms and moods. Not just when you start and when you stop. This will help you to communicate your irregularities to your doctor if there are any.

author: Scrapkat75
title: Want to love it
review:
Pros
So pretty and Versatile 

App is straightforward 

Cycle tracking is interesting 

Cons
Sleep tracking is not accurate for me. I do wear it as a bracelet.  Gets me as asleep 1 hour later than I really do.  Wake up is ok.  But once you edit the times the graph redraws looking totally different 

Step count is not accurate since 9/22/15 update (way low)

Buggy when syncing: not consistent with timeframe downloaded. Doesn't like downloading often. Sometimes it says it syncs but nothing changes

author: Luvlynne
title: Love/Hate
review: I love tracking my steps & sleep, and the look, I get so many compliments everyday. BUT, I hate that it won't stay on. It refuses to stay on the necklace, the bracelet doesn't fit, and when I wear it on my pants, I forget and it falls in the toilet the second I pull my pants down. I'm over it. NEED a way to keep it on!

author: Coyotegirl332
title: Such a bad app
review: I really enjoy my leaf and I wanted to use the breathing exercises but they refused to download and after a half hour of watching it stay at 0% I tried just about everything to get it to work. I finally deleted the app and redownloaded it to see if that would help.  And now it won't even open or do anything rendering my leaf useless. Awesome.

author: Fayonayo
title: Love the LEAF and the app!
review: I have been looking for a quality activity plus tracker (plus meaning it does more than count my steps). I had backed Olive but they cancelled their production. Then I found LEAF. Firstly, I love the look of the wearable itself, stainless and wood, very jewelry-esque. The app is great too! Easy to use, nice looking UI, I even like the colors they chose. I also love the fact that the company is run by women for women. I would recommend the LEAF and app to any woman! **Note-you need the LEAF wearable to use the app!

author: Beeeabeeeeee
title: This app needs IMPROVEMENT
review: Ok, so first off, bellabeat are saying that they will be improving the app. Which is good, cos it currently is doing about 1% of what other apps like it can do. At the moment, it's a glorified pedometer that only sometimes works, and a sleep monitor that also functions questionably. The app doesn't work with other apps, and it won't let you input anything you've done like a yoga class or swimming. The period tracker is AWFUL and you're much better off using another app for it. There is no way to view cumulative data, like your sleep over the last 7 days or last month.  Overall, the app has very little functionality. I'm looking forward to this improving markedly, in the meantime I might just stop using the leaf cos it's not really doing much

author: thechampishere93
title: Great design and personalized tracking
review: This is the activity tracking app I've always wanted but never found....until now. I love how it just works without much effort on my part. It helps me track my daily activities, distance travelled and my sleep routine has improved significantly. Keeping track of my monthly cycle and doing the recommended exercises have improved my reproductive health as well. Highly recommended.

author: RocketDogs
title: Good idea, not my favourite
review:
I have had my leaf for just over a week now and here is an honest account of how it has been for me. 

I like the versatility of how you can wear it, and I also dislike the versatility. 
1. Worn as a clip on the waistband - good for when you are doing the breathing exercises (which I really like because they do help to relax you) or for sleeping (assuming you don't sleep nude) but depending on the type of waistband, it will sometimes fall off when you go to use the bathroom. And you never know when it will until it has happened. I've almost lost it in the toilet a few times. (Also then it falls on the floor which can be gross if out in a public bathroom, but you also risk damage to the leaf)
2. Worn as a clip on my bra/shirt - no issues while going to the bathroom, stays put and is fairly comfy. The downside is that when I take off said bra or shirt I sometimes forget it is there and then have to hunt it down later in a mild panic, fitness at this time is not being tracked. 
3. Worn as a bracelet - good option if you are not doing anything that causes it to be in the way (ie: dishes, gardening) and are using it as an accessory only. It can be a little bulky depending on what size your wrist is, but looks nice.  Good for sleeping, but does not track sleep properly. 
4. Worn as a necklace - this is a good all around option except I found it did not track my sleep well when worn this way. I did find that because it is a little bulky, doing anything that involves a lot of active movement like running and jumping, will cause it to flop around on your chest. I made the chain that came with it able to fit through both fasteners on it so it could be worn horizontally across my chest rather than hang down vertically and this made it more secure and more comfortable for me. 

It seems to keep a fairly accurate count of my steps, but the sleep tracker is sometimes a little bit off and the fertility tracker (for me) is the biggest issue. It only tracks ovulation based on your estimated period and not by basal body temperature. This means that the day it says you are ovulating may not actually be the day you ovulate, especially for women who have really long or irregular cycles or for women who have come off of hormonal birth control. (Ovulation can take months or even years to return after the use of hormonal birth control, and the return of periods don't indicate ovulation) And for those who are trying to become pregnant, this can also be an issue, especially if they have been trying with no success. (In which case I would highly recommend researching the fertility awareness method before considering yourself infertile. "Taking charge of your fertility" by Toni Weschler is a great book for this. Sorry for the plug, but it cleared up a lot of questions I had regarding my cycles and my own fertility. Especially after having been on hormonal birth control for years.) 

All in all, I like the breathing exercises and the step counter, the look of the leaf itself is very nice, the easiness of the app is great but the versatility of how it can be worn is both a positive and negative for me, but unfortunately a little bit more on the negative. Like 45/55 pos to neg. simply because in between switching it around and the few times I lose it in the house I also lose fitness data, and have almost lost it to a watery porcelain grave a few times. 

If you are looking for a basic step counter and a nice piece of jewelry, then the leaf is great, however I would not recommend it for any type of serious ovulation tracking, even if you have regular cycles. Also you can buy cheaper step counters, cheaper jewelry that is less bulky and there are free ovulation/period tracking apps. 

Also, I am now finding that it is not tracking my sleep properly unless I wear it only on my waist band at night, which is annoying because I ( upcoming tmi, sorry) do like to sleep nude. Thinking of sending it back.

author: Jacquelinecanada
title: Worked for a few days, then stopped
review: Such a tease! The app and Leaf worked for the first few days I had them - just long enough to get excited about the possibilities. But then the sleep tracking functionality stopped working - my sleep is at 0 every night, although the activity tracker still kept recording numbers. Then the app stopped syncing to the Leaf - it connects and starts syncing, but then either gets stuck there forever, or if it makes it to 'processing, just a few more moments', it gets stuck there forever. Have tried over 20 times in the last 10 days, no success. Looked for an app update - nothing. I tried to be patient - they're new! - and wrote to help by email (the in-app help option has a number of bugs, most notably that after you write your message there is no Send button!), but I have received no reply after a week. So now all I have is a piece of bulky jewelry - which I am still wearing 24-7, hoping it will spring back to life! After waiting a few months for it to ship, this was seriously disappointing. I rarely leave bad reviews, but wanted to warn others to save them the same disappointment :(

author: Miss Hullabaloo
title: Pretty inaccurate and needs way more features
review: I was so excited to get my leaf! Its a nice design and the concept is good. I really want to love it but unfortunately the step counter is very inaccurate, some of the features that were marketed prior to purchase are not available. This could be so much more than it currently is. Please bellabeat make it as amazing as it should be, and this will be a massive success.

author: Rachiecandice
title: Received LEAF today...
review:
In my 12 hours of wearing the leaf I've happily done two breathing exercises (though unwell and can't 'breathe through the nose' but I tried my best!). I've added sleep and menstruation data from other apps.
I've had my iPhone 6+ on me all day to compare step tracking and according to the phone I tripled my steps according to the leaf. Also right as we speak I'm watching TV and the leaf informed me I've been asleep for 2 hours.
I'm sure these are just early bugs that need to be sorted out. I love the design and can't wait to play with more data.

author: KayeElleEm
title: Disappointing
review:
I was expecting more from this than just simply measuring sleep and steps and was hoping this was 'feature set one' with enhancements on the way...

However when the app tells me that I went to sleep at 0200, woke at 0830 and as such had slept 13 hours and overachieved on my sleep goal any faith I now have in the tech behind this limited feature set simply left the building... 

Such a shame :(

author: FlowerChild258
title: Pretty
review: Both the leaf and the app are really pretty. Quite impressive so far.
